meta.name: opportunity-solution-tree
meta.description: Build an Opportunity Solution Tree from outcomes to opportunities, solutions, and tests. Use when a stakeholder request needs problem framing before you decide what to build.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将利益相关者请求转化为机会解决方案树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发前先系统性地框架化问题
copy.tagline_en: Turn stakeholder requests into an Opportunity Solution Tree
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to frame problems before deciding what to build

howto.what: Claude引导你构建机会解决方案树：提取目标成果，识别机会（用户问题），生成方案，评估并选择最佳POC。全程交互式提问。
howto.when: 当你提出功能需求、产品计划或模糊OKR，且需要先理解问题再决定构建什么时触发。尤其适用于需要结构化发现的过程。

say.text: 我刚收到一个用户反馈，想分析它背后的问题机会。
say.note: Claude会开始收集上下文并引导OST流程。

say.text: 我的产品目标是提高试用转付费率，帮我创建机会解决方案树。
say.note: Claude会提取目标成果并生成机会选项。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you to build an Opportunity Solution Tree: extract desired outcomes, identify opportunities (user problems), generate solutions, evaluate and select the best POC. Fully interactive step-by-step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you present a feature request, product initiative, or vague OKR that needs problem framing before deciding what to build. Best for structured discovery.

say_en.text: I just got user feedback, help me analyze the underlying problem and opportunity.
say_en.note: Claude will gather context and start the OST process.

say_en.text: My product goal is to increase trial-to-paid conversion. Build a tree for me.
say_en.note: Claude will extract outcome and generate opportunity options.
